purpose: Test a chart-reviewable long-only mother built from an above-normal broad-market stock-specific dispersion state and an extreme current move relative to PIT industry. Direction is unresolved, so upward and downward idiosyncratic tails remain separate outcome-blind lanes.

v28_semantic_correction.observed_without_outcomes: V28 incorrectly applied the candidate liquidity/history filters before constructing the market state. Requiring at least 500 securities after removing the less-liquid half made the market calendar structurally incomplete and produced zero candidates before any outcome or chart was read.
v28_semantic_correction.correction: Construct the market dispersion state from every currently valid security with a valid current step and PIT industry. Apply the exact 60-session history and same-date median-liquidity requirements only to securities that may become candidates.
v28_semantic_correction.not_a_result_rescue: No V28 return, future path, or chart was read. V29 changes the economic state from rare p80 dispersion to above-normal p50 dispersion because the outcome-blind p80 weekly state had zero decision dates in 2016 and could not satisfy the predeclared annual opportunity gate. No threshold grid is permitted.

broad_market_state.current_member: Current row is hard/current valid, tradable, trade_status=1, market/corporate-action valid, non-blocking, no current corporate action, historical identity and PIT industry valid, non-ST, available_at <= decision_at, with positive finite coordinate prices, amount, and current step_return.
broad_market_state.industry_step: Same-date median current step_return for PIT industries with at least 10 broad valid members.
broad_market_state.stock_specific_step: Current security step_return minus its same-date PIT-industry median step_return.
broad_market_state.dispersion: Same-date cross-sectional IQR of broad-member stock_specific_step_return, requiring at least 500 securities and 20 PIT industries.
broad_market_state.causal_history: Exactly 252 strictly prior consecutive global market cal_idx observations. The current date is excluded.
broad_market_state.above_normal_state: Current broad-market dispersion is at or above the median of those exact 252 prior completed observations.
broad_market_state.weekly_clock: Completed Friday close only; no weekday search.
broad_market_state.economic_meaning: Stock-specific price discovery is wider than its own causal one-year norm, so security selection has more cross-sectional opportunity than in a common-mode market. This is an applicability state, not a directional market-return prediction.

candidate_security.history: Exactly 60 strictly prior consecutive market-session rows with unchanged coordinate lineage and all required PIT validity flags.
candidate_security.current: Same current validity contract as broad members.
candidate_security.liquidity: Current amount is at or above the causal same-date median among history-eligible securities whose PIT industry has at least 10 broad current members.

direction_lanes.IDIOSYNCRATIC_UP_SHOCK: Candidate stock-specific step return is in the current liquid-candidate top decile.
direction_lanes.IDIOSYNCRATIC_DOWN_SHOCK: Candidate stock-specific step return is in the current liquid-candidate bottom decile.

candidate_security.industry_representation: Within each PIT industry and lane keep the eligible tail stock with the largest current amount; tie-break lexically by symbol.
candidate_security.cooldown: After a selected symbol event, suppress later events for the next 20 global market cal_idx values, applied causally in chronological order.

stage_a_gate.action_if_failed: Close before charts or outcomes. Do not change p50, decile, liquidity, weekday, industry, or cooldown definitions.

chart_plan_if_gate_passes.window: 126 sessions before through 126 sessions after signal. Signals stop at 2020-12-31 and chart context is capped at 2021-06-30.
chart_plan_if_gate_passes.review: Render every candidate; inspect every chronological contact sheet; then inspect all complete outcome-group contradiction sheets.
chart_plan_if_gate_passes.later_validation_gate: Only after frozen chart rules produce more than 50 completed signals and mean net return above 4% in every development year may 2022-2024 be opened once.

prohibited: percentile, lookback, weekday, Top-N, target, or holding-period grids
silent substitution for missing PIT industry or lineage
2021+ signal outcomes before development chart rules are frozen
